caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass object resembling a decorative stopper or finial, set against a plain, light beige background. The glass object is vertically aligned and consists of several distinct segments. At the top, there is a flared rim with scalloped edges and faceted, textured detailing. Below it is a narrow neck that widens into a bulbous midsection, which features etched or engraved white floral patterns. The glass then transitions into a spirally-grooved banded segment, followed by a longer cylindrical section that is completely smooth and transparent with subtle light reflections and two O-shaped highlights. The overall color of the glass is clear with blue-gray and white highlights, which are used to indicate transparency, gloss, and shadow. The composition centers the object on the page, and the only other visible mark is a small handwritten signature at the bottom right corner.
title: Caster Bottle
